title: Prove the partition homotopy
promptMarkdown: For alternating smooth $q$-form cochains of positive Čech degree, define $K$ as in the lesson. Prove $\delta K+K\delta=I$, including the support and local-finiteness justification. Deduce that a Čech cocycle with smooth-form coefficients is a coboundary. Explain why this proof does not show that $\check H^1(S^1;\mathbb R)=0$.
hintLadder: Write the j term as the first index in the coboundary expansion.
The term omitting j survives; all other terms cancel.
Check whether multiplying a constant by a partition function remains locally constant.
